articles.title: Jefferies warns against buying the dip in Circle as Open USD raises new competition fears
articles.snippet: The investment bank said new competition from the Stripe- and Coinbase-backed stablecoin consortium could pressure USDC's growth.

articles.title: Goliath Ventures CEO pleads guilty in $400 million crypto Ponzi case
articles.snippet: Christopher Delgado allegedly used investor funds for a lavish lifestyle, including luxury properties and vehicles, while running a fraudulent scheme from 2023 to 2026.

articles.title: Europe's MiCA rollout sparks debate over who wins under new crypto rules
articles.snippet: As Europe's crypto rulebook takes full effect, industry leaders agree regulation is here to stay, but disagree over whether it protects consumers or favors the biggest firms.

articles.title: Europe is closing the door on offshore crypto, but it’s leaving the riskiest window open
articles.snippet: MiCA was never meant to address the giant crypto derivatives market. That could pose a serious problem, says Patrick Gruhn, founder and chief executive of Perpetuals.com.

articles.title: Ethereum gets a new nonprofit focused on institutional adoption
articles.snippet: The launch comes as the Ethereum Foundation narrows its focus to stewarding the core protocol, with independent organizations like EthLabs emerging to take on ecosystem functions such as research & development.
